page: Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by AMD EPYC 9V45 processors operating at up to 4.5 GHz. The instance delivers 80 dedicated x86_64 physical cores mapped directly to 80 vCPUs with 1 thread per core. The CPU architecture includes hardware support for AVX-512 extensions such as AVX-512 VNNI and BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration instructions including AES and SHA-NI. The memory subsystem is configured with 320.0 GB of RAM, equating to 4.0 GB per core, backed by 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster.

Local I/O capability is provided by 9,449 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage, offering high local capacity without reliance solely on remote network-attached disks. The instance does not include GPU accelerators, directing its processing capacity entirely toward dense host CPU workloads. Benchmark results highlight top-tier standing across multiple compute and memory metrics, recording 290,168.74 in stress-ng multi-core tests and a PassMark CPU score of 128,668.08. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 476.02 GB/sec, while write operations achieve 213.34 GB/sec.

Data handling performance is further reflected in specialized benchmarks, including 202.34 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 111.41 GB/sec. Large-scale data compression and decompression yield 1,012.5 GB/sec on multi-threaded bzip3 tasks. In CPU-driven language model inference, prompt processing throughput reaches 5,722.82 tokens per second on small 135M models and 294.76 tokens per second on 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F80ads_v7 offers high resource density by packing 80 physical cores and massive local NVMe storage into a single host footprint, minimizing multi-node orchestration overhead. However, the lack of discrete GPU hardware bounds its utility for intensive large-model training or real-time high-throughput generative AI text generation. The configuration is primarily fit for compute-heavy parallel workloads, batch data processing, high-throughput caching tiers, relational databases requiring fast local scratch disks, and compiler or build infrastructure.
description: Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine featuring 80 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor running at 4.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture incorporates AVX-512 instructions, AES, and SHA-NI cryptographic support. Paired with 320.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core) and 9,449 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, the instance is engineered for demanding compute and data-intensive tasks without GPU acceleration. Across benchmarks, the F80ads_v7 establishes top-tier multi-core execution (290,168.74 in stress-ng), sustained memory bandwidth up to 476.02 GB/sec uncached, and high key-value throughput with 202.34 million Redis SET operations per second. Delivering high single-node density, it serves compute-heavy analytics, large-scale software builds, database processing, and batch transformations.
